title: I Gave the Grok Bot AI Trading Bot $10,000 for 22 Hours… Here’s What Happened
description:
👉🏻 Learn AI trading bots and algorithmic trading with us:  
https://www.skool.com/daviddtech/about?sl=yt_muHeyXiCn-A

👉🏻 Get the FREE GrokBot prompts, workbooks, checklists and resources:  
DM me “AI TRADING” on Instagram:  
https://instagram.com/DaviddTech

I gave the GrokBot AI trading bot access to a $10,000 trading account and 22 hours to trade autonomously—but I didn’t give it a trading strategy.

Could GrokBot create its own rules, execute real trades and finish profitably?

While it was trading, I gave GrokBot a second challenge: build a complete no-code AI trading desk capable of researching ideas, developing strategies, backtesting them, optimizing their settings and preparing them for forward testing.

This recreates the workflow behind the automated trading system that recorded 102% over a 12-month period—but this time, we’re attempting to build everything inside GrokBot.

You’ll see the complete setup, the prompts, every trade GrokBot executed, its final report and the best strategy its AI agents discovered.

## In this video, you’ll discover:

✅ How GrokBot’s multi-agent system works  
✅ How to connect GrokBot to a Bybit trading account  
✅ How to install the Trigger.trade trading skill  
✅ The prompt used to turn GrokBot into an autonomous AI trader  
✅ The risk rules placed on the $10,000 account  
✅ How GrokBot created its own trading logic and schedule  
✅ How to build a complete no-code AI trading desk  
✅ How research, development, optimization and risk agents work together  
✅ How to connect GrokBot to TradingKit and backtest TradingView strategies  
✅ How GrokBot tested approximately 50 strategy ideas  
✅ Every trade from the 22-hour live experiment  
✅ GrokBot’s final profit, losses, fees and win rate  
✅ The best strategy its agents discovered  
✅ Why impressive backtests still require forward testing  
✅ Why I will incubate the strategy for three months before risking serious capital
